name: Cordless Drill
instruction: Design a cordless drill with a rechargeable battery pack at the base, a trigger for variable speed control, and a chuck for holding different drill bits. Include a built-in LED light near the chuck to illuminate the work area.

Shape accuracy: The object is a cordless drill.
The drill has a cylindrical body.
The base is wider to accommodate the rechargeable battery pack.
The chuck is located at the front of the drill.
Color representation: The color set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Size: The size set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Proportion: The battery pack is proportionate to the size of the drill body.
The chuck is appropriately sized for standard drill bits.
Texture and surface detail: The texture and surface detail set in the script is reasonable for the object.

Three-dimensional spatial awareness: The battery pack is securely attached to the base of the drill.
The trigger is positioned for easy access with the index finger.
The chuck is aligned with the drill body for proper bit insertion.
The LED light is positioned near the chuck for optimal illumination.
Object distance and contact: There is no overlap between the battery pack and the drill body.
The trigger is easily reachable without obstruction.
The LED light is mounted securely and does not interfere with the chuck.

Instruction execution accuracy: All specified features, including the battery pack, trigger, chuck, and LED light, are accurately represented.
There are no deviations from the instructions provided.
